authority.owner_text: ISO/IEC 17025-accredited laboratory with the relevant measurement explicitly inside its accredited scope (in India normally an appropriate NABL-accredited scope). Witness mass: SI-traceable microbalance calibration with OIML E2 or better certified reference masses where appropriate (OIML R111 certificates and traceability). Profilometry: calibration/verification with traceable surface standards consistent with ISO 25178-700. Quantitative SEM/EDS: documented quantitative method consistent with ASTM E1508. XPS energy-scale calibration per ISO 15472 or equivalent traceable procedure. No commercial lab is named yet: W4 issues the measurement specification first, then a lab satisfying it is procured.

not_a_procurement: No laboratory is named, searched or contacted. This specification is issued first; a lab satisfying it is procured afterwards (A3). Nothing here is a measurement.

general_requirements.requirement: ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation with the SPECIFIC measurement (measurand, method, range and calibration and measurement capability) explicitly inside the accredited scope; in India normally an appropriate NABL-accredited scope (A3; REF-ISO17025, REF-NABL)
general_requirements.verification: copy of the current scope document and accreditation certificate; the scope lines that cover each MS-M item are cited in the offer

general_requirements.requirement: SI traceability of every result through an unbroken calibration chain; certificates of the reference standards used (masses, surface standards, reference foils, length standards) supplied with the report
general_requirements.verification: certificate numbers and validity dates in every report

general_requirements.requirement: uncertainty evaluated per the GUM (REF-GUM2008): Type A and Type B components listed; expanded uncertainty with its coverage factor k and coverage probability; planning k = 2 (A3); where effective degrees of freedom are low, the evaluated k and nu_eff are stated (REF-GUM2008 G.4.1; for masses also REF-OIML-R111-1 C.6.5.1)
general_requirements.verification: uncertainty budget attached to each report

general_requirements.requirement: raw data (every individual reading, instrument settings, environment log) delivered in machine-readable form with the report; Vyovrinda may publish them
general_requirements.verification: data files and their checksums listed in the report

general_requirements.requirement: blind coded sample ids only (INS-P-01); the lab never receives configuration, arm or exposure information
the same instrument, method and (coded) operator for baseline and post-test measurements of an item (INS-P-02, INS-20)
general_requirements.verification: instrument serial and operator code in each report

general_requirements.requirement: no subcontracting of a measurement outside the lab's own accredited scope without written agreement; a subcontracted measurement must itself satisfy MS-G-01
proficiency-testing or interlaboratory-comparison evidence for each measurand where the accreditation body requires it
general_requirements.verification: latest results for the relevant scope lines (verify the accreditation body's policy)

references.access: full text read 2026-09-27 (PDF text extraction): 5.2 (U for k = 2 of the conventional mass <= 1/3 of the MPE, Eq. 5.2-1), Table 1 (MPE, +/- delta_m in mg), C.6.5.1 (k = 2 usually; t-distribution at 95.5 % with Welch-Satterthwaite nu_eff when fewer than 10 measurements and the weighing term dominates).
